name: 底比斯的梦魇
desc: ①：自己手卡和自己的魔法与陷阱区域没有卡存在的场合，这张卡的攻击力上升1500。
faq: If you have only "Kuriboh" in your hand, and no Spell or Trap Cards on the field, and your "Theban Nightmare" battles with a card that has higher ATK/DEF, and you discard "Kuriboh", the ATK of "Theban Nightmare" is increased by 1500 AFTER damage calculation (but "Theban Nightmare" is still destroyed by damage calculation unless an effect like "Waboku" had been activated previously during the turn).
